meta.title: Loop board
meta.description: What is done when something happens or the time comes: rows hand their entries, events and actions to the loop board, which checks and lists them, and brings four entries of its own (dependency check after a merge, a reminder for what has waited for you too long, the two ends of a GLM peak). It also keeps the entries a person added, and in a process that can reach a session it beats and runs what is due. The delivery to the main agent, the tools and the pages are not here yet. Off by default.
